newsitem.title: USA: Ellett Bros sees sharply lower Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: Ellett Bros sees sharply lower Q3 results.

text.p: Ellett Brothers Inc said on Wednesday third quarter net income would be lower than the prior-year period by at least half.

The sporting goods company said in a statement that sales were expected to be essentially flat with the third quarter of 1995. The lower net income will result from gross profit margin pressures combined with other factors.

President Joseph Murray, said, "As a result of these factors, we currently expect earnings per share for the quarter to be in the $0.08 to $0.10 per share range, versus $0.21 in the third quarter of 1995."
The company reported net income of $1.12 million on sales of $39 million in the third quarter of 1995.

Murray said, "The highly competitive market during the slowdown in the hunting and shooting sports industry has eased slightly. However, a larger percentage of sales (is) coming in the lower-gross-margin categories, negatively impacting the overall gross profit margin of the company."
